content.text:
rootProject.name = "urbo-cms"

pluginManagement {
    repositories {
        // Build-logic plugins (io.swcode.urbo.build.logic.*) are resolved from the public,
        // read-only S3 maven repo — no credentials required.
        maven {
            url = uri("https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases")
            mavenContent {
                includeGroupByRegex("io\\.swcode.*")
            }
        }
        mavenCentral()
        gradlePluginPortal()
    }
}

plugins {
    // Apply the foojay-resolver plugin to allow automatic download of JDKs
    id("org.gradle.toolchains.foojay-resolver-convention") version "1.0.0"
    id("de.fayard.refreshVersions") version "0.60.6"
}

refreshVersions {
    rejectVersionIf {
        candidate.stabilityLevel.isLessStableThan(de.fayard.refreshVersions.core.StabilityLevel.Stable)
    }
}

include(
    "urbo-account-api",
    "urbo-app",
    "urbo-authorization-api",
    "urbo-casbin",
    "urbo-catalog",
    "urbo-command",
    "urbo-common",
    "urbo-core",
    "urbo-core-api",
    "urbo-core-starter",
    "urbo-image",
    "urbo-image-processing-client",
    "urbo-queue",
    "urbo-s3",
    "urbo-search-meilisearch",
    "urbo-keycloak-adapter",
    "urbo-auth-adapter",
    "urbo-user-management",
    "urbo-web",
    "urbo-meilisearch-api",
    "urbo-s3-api",
    "urbo-command-api",
    "urbo-platform",
    "urbo-search-index",
    "urbo-search-index-starter",
    "urbo-s3-starter",
    "urbo-stele",
    "urbo-history",
    "urbo-notification-api",
    "urbo-notification-sendinblue",
===

observation.command: cat backend/settings.gradle.kts | head -60; echo "==="; grep -rn "packages\|maven" backend/gradle.properties 2>/dev/null | head
